_comment: publish-chain job — the ONLY job that publishes. Publishes each target in
plan order (children FIRST — a published parent must never point at an
unpublished child).
Runner: scripts/runners/publish_chain.py (kind: publish-chain).
THE PUBLISH GATE: approved_by AND approved_at must BOTH be non-empty or the
runner REFUSES to run (both validate() and run() enforce it). They stay EMPTY
in this template on purpose — the physio's sign-off in the Review & publish
flow writes the prose approval into brief.md AND fills these two fields. Never
fill them on your own initiative.
MCP publish availability varies by token: if publish_<type> answers 'disabled'
the runner exits with code 2 and log.txt carries an ordered admin-UI click list
(children first) — hand that list to the physio to click Publish in Strapi admin.
'_comment' is ignored by the runner — it reads only the keys below via plan.get().
Fields:
kind        : must be 'publish-chain'.
env         : MCP registration name; `--env` overrides it.
approved_by : physio's stated identity — filled ONLY at sign-off (empty here).
approved_at : ISO timestamp of sign-off — filled ONLY at sign-off (empty here).
targets[]   : ordered list, CHILDREN FIRST —
type       : the SINGULAR type id (used as publish_<type>), e.g.
program-exercise-template, program-template, survey-template-question,
survey-template, omni-rom-program-exercise, omni-rom-program,
calendar-program-template, exercise,
documentId : the draft's documentId,
label      : optional human label for the click-list/report.
